title: PCRE2 archive digest can be unset before Framework extraction
title_de: PCRE2-Archiv-Digest kann vor Framework-Extraction unset sein
summary: The Framework PCRE2 source-archive path previously accepted an empty digest and could extract unverified bytes. The task branch now requires a reviewed SHA-256 literal before the real extraction sink and retains focused local proof.
summary_de: Der Framework-PCRE2-Source-Archive-Pfad akzeptierte zuvor einen leeren Digest und konnte unverifizierte Bytes extrahieren. Der Task-Branch verlangt nun vor dem realen Extraction-Sink ein geprüftes SHA-256-Literal und behält fokussierten lokalen Nachweis.
observed_behavior: Before the fix, PCRE2_SHA256 and PCRE2_SHA256_URL defaulted to empty and optional verification helpers returned successfully before extraction. After the fix, empty, whitespace-only, malformed, and mismatching PCRE2_SHA256 values exit 77 before the PCRE2 archive reaches tar; the matching local fixture reaches the expected extraction path.
observed_behavior_de: Vor dem Fix waren PCRE2_SHA256 und PCRE2_SHA256_URL standardmäßig leer und optionale Verifikations-Helper kehrten vor der Extraction erfolgreich zurück. Nach dem Fix enden leere, nur-Whitespace-, malformed und abweichende PCRE2_SHA256-Werte mit 77, bevor das PCRE2-Archiv tar erreicht; das passende lokale Fixture erreicht den erwarteten Extraction-Pfad.
expected_behavior: No PCRE2 archive may reach extraction or any later processing until a non-empty, syntactically valid, exactly matching SHA-256 digest has been verified.
expected_behavior_de: Kein PCRE2-Archiv darf Extraction oder weitere Verarbeitung erreichen, bevor ein nicht leerer, syntaktisch gültiger und exakt passender SHA-256-Digest verifiziert wurde.
impact: The implemented control closes the previously optional archive-integrity boundary in the Framework PCRE2 provisioning path. Current-head PR verification remains blocked by the independent FND-FRAMEWORK-0001 common-structure failure.
impact_de: Die implementierte Kontrolle schließt die zuvor optionale Archive-Integrity-Grenze im Framework-PCRE2-Provisioning-Pfad. Die PR-Verifikation des aktuellen Heads bleibt durch den unabhängigen common-structure-Fehler FND-FRAMEWORK-0001 blockiert.
preconditions: The Framework Apache PCRE2 source-build path is invoked.
A caller provides the PCRE2 archive source and may override PCRE2_SHA256.
The retained assessment and task-run evidence remain available.
reproduction: Pre-fix: inspect the optional digest helpers before the PCRE2 extract_tar_strip sink in the Framework base revision.
Post-fix: run tests.security_regression.test_pcre2_archive_digest through the actual prepare-apache-build.sh entry point with the isolated local archive fixture.

root_cause: The Apache PCRE2 provisioning path treated both digest sources as optional: the verification helpers returned successfully for empty input and extraction followed immediately.
root_cause_de: Der Apache-PCRE2-Provisioning-Pfad behandelte beide Digest-Quellen als optional: Die Verifikations-Helper kehrten bei leerer Eingabe erfolgreich zurück und die Extraction folgte unmittelbar.
proposed_remediation: Implemented a reviewed PCRE2 SHA-256 default that preserves explicit empty overrides, a PCRE2-specific required 64-hex verifier, exact archive hashing before the sole extraction sink, and isolated negative/control regressions with tar instrumentation.
proposed_remediation_de: Implementiert wurden ein geprüftes PCRE2-SHA-256-Default, das explizit leere Overrides erhält, ein PCRE2-spezifischer erforderlicher 64-Hex-Verifier, exaktes Archive-Hashing vor dem einzigen Extraction-Sink sowie isolierte Negative-/Kontrollregressionen mit tar-Instrumentierung.
acceptance_criteria: An empty, whitespace-only, syntactically invalid, or mismatching PCRE2 digest fails before extraction or further processing.
Every negative case proves that the PCRE2 archive did not reach tar.
A syntactically valid exactly matching digest permits the isolated fixture archive to reach the expected extraction path.
validation_plan: Run the actual preparation script with isolated empty, whitespace-only, malformed, and mismatching digest fixtures and capture tar instrumentation.
Run the matching-digest control through the same script boundary.
Run focused Framework regression, syntax, documentation, lint/static-analysis, ShellCheck, and source-to-sink checks.
regression_tests: tests/security_regression/test_pcre2_archive_digest.py: four negative digest cases plus one matching control through ci/provisioning/prepare-apache-build.sh.
legitimate_control_tests: A correct SHA-256 for the deterministic local PCRE2 fixture exits 0, reaches the PCRE2 tar marker once, and completes the fixture pcre2-config path.

root_cause_triage.source: Before the fix, downloaded PCRE2 archive bytes came from PCRE2_SOURCE_URL while PCRE2_SHA256 and PCRE2_SHA256_URL defaulted to empty values in ci/lib/common.sh.
root_cause_triage.broken_control_or_sink: Before the fix, generic digest helpers returned success for empty input and extraction followed. The fixed path calls verify_required_pcre2_sha256 at ci/provisioning/prepare-apache-build.sh:363 immediately before extract_tar_strip at :364.
attacker_preconditions: A PCRE2 source build is selected and the digest is unset or overridden empty before the pre-fix control.
The external archive is substituted or otherwise differs from the intended asset before download consumption.
No substituted archive was fetched or executed in this read-only triage.
root_cause_triage.impact: Before the fix, unverified archive contents could be extracted and built in the Framework Apache provisioning path.
countercontrols: download_file requires HTTPS and records a local SHA-256.
The fixed PCRE2-specific verifier rejects empty, malformed, and mismatching input before extraction; PCRE2_SHA256_URL is not an extraction-verification fallback.
root_cause_triage.root_control_boundary: Framework Apache PCRE2 archive-integrity enforcement before extraction.
root_cause_triage.parent_impact: None for this triage. A later Framework fix has no Parent source change and requires a separate authorized gitlink update if consumed by Parent.
root_cause_triage.mrts_impact: none; no MRTS path is involved.
required_regression_tests: Missing, whitespace-only, malformed, and mismatched PCRE2 digests fail before tar extraction using isolated fixtures with no tar marker.
A matching expected digest allows the fixture archive to reach the extraction path.
required_legitimate_control_cases: A correct reviewed PCRE2 digest with the deterministic local archive succeeds through the real preparation-script boundary.
bypass_review: PCRE2_SHA256_URL fallback, explicit empty environment overrides, case normalization, malformed digest input, archive mismatch, and archive-path replacement.
root_cause_triage.delivery_boundary: Framework-only branch codex/fix-framework-pcre2-digest and Draft PR #22; Parent gitlink unchanged; MRTS untouched. SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate passed, but the current PR head cannot reach verified_pr while the pre-existing FND-FRAMEWORK-0001 common-structure check fails.
proof_gaps: No upstream archive substitution or full Apache build was run; the isolated fixture exercises the actual enforcement boundary as authorized by the task.
Current-head verified_pr remains blocked by the independently tracked FND-FRAMEWORK-0001 CI condition.

remediation_validation.source_to_sink_before: PCRE2_SOURCE_URL download -> optional literal/URL verification that returned success for empty input -> extract_tar_strip pcre2.
remediation_validation.broken_control_before: PCRE2_SHA256 and PCRE2_SHA256_URL defaulted to empty values; neither optional helper made a digest mandatory before tar extraction.
remediation_validation.control_after: PCRE2_SHA256 defaults to a reviewed literal unless explicitly set; explicit empty input remains empty and is rejected. verify_required_pcre2_sha256 requires exactly 64 hexadecimal characters, normalizes case, hashes the archive, compares exact equality, and only then allows extract_tar_strip.
remediation_validation.negative_result: Empty, whitespace-only, 64-character non-hex, and valid-shape wrong digest cases each exited 77 and wrote no PCRE2 archive marker to the fake tar log.
remediation_validation.legitimate_result: The matching deterministic local bzip2 fixture exited 0, wrote one PCRE2 tar marker, and completed the fixture pcre2-config path.
remediation_validation.bypass_review: The no-colon PCRE2_SHA256 expansion preserves explicit empty overrides for rejection; PCRE2_SHA256_URL has no fallback role; source review confirms the required verifier is immediately before the sole PCRE2 extraction sink.

fixture JSON syntax, sh -n, and bash -n: passed

residual_risk: The task branch enforces the PCRE2 archive-digest boundary and has local source-to-sink proof. The independently tracked FND-FRAMEWORK-0001 common-structure failure prevents current-head verified_pr; no risk has been accepted and no merge occurred.
residual_risk_de: Der Task-Branch erzwingt die PCRE2-Archive-Digest-Grenze und besitzt lokalen Source-to-Sink-Nachweis. Der unabhängig verfolgte common-structure-Fehler FND-FRAMEWORK-0001 verhindert verified_pr für den aktuellen Head; kein Risiko wurde akzeptiert und kein Merge erfolgte.

history.detail: Created by the one-time finding-management bootstrap from retained evidence; no remediation, verification, closure, or risk acceptance was performed.

Current Framework static evidence at cdc91a398d6c156eaff927d742b23018a3817fb6 confirms optional PCRE2 digest enforcement before extraction. It remains separate from the NGINX digest finding because the consumer, helpers, patch, and regression fixtures differ.

The Framework task branch implements a required PCRE2 digest verifier immediately before extraction and focused actual-script regressions prove the four negative cases never reach tar while the matching control succeeds. Draft PR #22 is retained without merge; its current-head verified_pr is blocked only by the pre-existing FND-FRAMEWORK-0001 common-structure failure, while the SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate passed.

Direct current-master comparisons show that stale PR heads #24, #27, and #29 restore empty PCRE2 digest defaults, optional-success verification, and extraction/build after the skipped check. The source-to-sink condition is retained as an unmerged merge blocker only; Framework master 9954b99a31fab0006cdf903ab477c8158c50fea8 remains fixed.
